newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse holds firm, milk company STIL plunges.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse holds firm, milk company STIL plunges.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed 0.67 percent higher on Thursday, traders said.
The firmer tone came despite a steep fall by state-controlled milk company STIL on its first day of trading, bourse sources said.
The 31 share index closed at 489.23 points from 485.98 on Wednesday.
Volume was 1.06 million dinars against 1.92 million dinars.
Societe Tunisienne des Industries Laitieres dropped 7.41 dinars to 7.0 dinars. Brokers linked the fall to the introduction of computerised dealing on the bourse, with its greater transparency.

Since last October, the Tunis Stock Exchange has been gradually introducing computerised dealing for listed firms, and the system now includes 25 out of 31 issues in the index. Most computerised shares dropped sharply when they made the switch.
ICF rose 3.7 dinars to 43.7 dinars. Chemical firm AL KIMIA was up 1.5 dinar to 44.5. Arab Tunisian Bank won 1.0 dinar to 30 dinars.
Retail stores MONOPRIX gained 0.94 dinar to 35.38 dinars. UBCI bank advanced 1.2 dinars to 46.9 dinars.
Airline Tunis Air was down 0.8 dinar to 19.1 dinars. Banque Nationale Agricole fell 0.93 dinar to 30.07 dinars. ($= 1.07 dinars)
